license_label: SKAO data-challenge usage stated as unrestricted
evidence: The official SKAO Data Challenges page states that usage of challenge data will be unrestricted. No SPDX-formatted licence was identified on the verified SDC3a pages, so the explicit usage statement is preserved as non-SPDX terms rather than translated into a licence identifier.

No explicit dataset-level reuse licence for the canonical UMass LFW resource was independently verified. Public benchmark availability, mirrors and citation instructions are not treated as a licence grant.

The canonical University of Toronto CIFAR page provides downloads, checksums and citation guidance but no explicit dataset-level licence was independently verified. No licence is inferred from the technical report or downstream software packages.
